classification.difficultyReason: Recover each frequency by subtracting consecutive cumulative totals, taking the first total as the first frequency. Both tables directly repeat this taught procedure without additional interpretation.

content.prompt: Determine the frequency from the cumulative frequency.

inlines.text: The first frequency equals the first cumulative total. Subtract the preceding cumulative total for each later score.
